# BotAvatarsKit core

MIT source: https://github.com/Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev
Pinned revision: bfcb86329da15235a5ee2dcdb6417c8a80f82bb1
Source folder: packages/bot-avatars/ports/ios/BotAvatarsKit/Sources/BotAvatarsKit

Includes the six drawing, material, shape, colour, type and animation engine files.
Local change: BotColor(Color) uses AppKit NSColor in sRGB instead of UIKit UIColor.
The app owns its window-bound display link and renders the public Canvas drawing API;
the upstream iOS clock, pointer/stage and view wrappers are intentionally not included.
No Studio, Pro presets, account, network service or runtime fees.
